description_en: Queries the diagnostic information about a Spark application
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-spark-app-diagnosis-info --db-cluster-id amv-uf663j39b0jd2000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-id s202411061017sh0ad564b0000000 --biz-language zh --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSparkAppDiagnosisInfo

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455888.html operation to query all application IDs
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455888.html接口查询所有的应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values:

en: English.
zh (default): Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型，返回结果将以该语言展示。取值如下： 

en：英文 
zh（默认值）：中文
parameters.name: language

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The information about the request denial

AppId.description_en:
The application ID.

You can call the [ListSparkApps]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455888.html） operation to query all application IDs
AppId.description_zh:
应用ID。
您可以调用[ListSparkApps]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455888.html）接口查询所有的应用ID

DurationInMillis.description_en: The execution duration of the application. Unit: milliseconds
DurationInMillis.description_zh: Spark应用执行耗时，单位毫秒（ms）

JVMGcCostInMillis.description_en: The amount of time consumed by the Java virtual machine to perform garbage collection operations. Unit: milliseconds
JVMGcCostInMillis.description_zh: Java虚拟机执行垃圾回收操作的耗时，单位是毫秒

PeakMemoryInByte.description_en: The peak memory usage. Unit: bytes
PeakMemoryInByte.description_zh: 峰值内存使用量，单位是Byte

ShuffleReadInByte.description_en: The amount of data used for shuffle reads. Unit: bytes
ShuffleReadInByte.description_zh: Shuffle读过程涉及到的数据量，单位是Byte

ShuffleWriteInByte.description_en: The amount of data used for shuffle writes. Unit: bytes
ShuffleWriteInByte.description_zh: Shuffle写过程的数据量，单位是Byte

SpillInByte.description_en: The amount of data spilled to disks when the memory is insufficient. Unit: bytes
SpillInByte.description_zh: 内存不足时，交换写入到磁盘的数据量，单位是Byte

StartedTime.description_en: The time when the application started to be executed

State.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous import or export job. Valid values:

RUNNING
FINISHED
FAILED
State.description_zh:
需要查询的异步导入或导出任务的状态，取值说明如下：
RUNNING：任务进行中。
FINISHED：任务执行成功。
FAILED：任务执行失败
